faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICMR Section Officer posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the ICMR Section Officer recruitment is 05 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Section Officer post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is any degree with a working knowledge of computers. For specific details, officers from Central/State Govt./Autonomous Body/PSU holding analogous posts or Assistants with 5 years of regular service are eligible.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the ICMR Section Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Section Officer post is 56 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Section Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Section Officer post will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Section Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 47 vacancies announced for the Section Officer post in the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the ICMR Section Officer posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Section Officer posts will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the ICMR Section Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article or from the official website of ICMR.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Deputation.
